effect_units: candidate pass fraction minus baseline pass fraction, case weighted

assumptions: Every row is one independent case evaluated once by the baseline and every candidate.
Case set, pass rule, candidate family and alpha were fixed before inspecting results.
All planned candidate comparisons against this baseline are included in this family.
These tests address equal discordance probabilities, not equivalence or practical value.
Repeated looks, case selection and correlated cases are not corrected here.
full_data_analysis.method: exact two-sided conditional McNemar per candidate; Holm step-down familywise correction

limitations: Declared clusters are assertions, not discovered or verified independence groups.

These overlapping deletions are diagnostics, not replacement analyses or multiple-testing-corrected new claims.
